$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Leak-free CSG calls
blocks.for: The three manifold-3d calls whose own glue leaks memory on every rebuild, without the leak. pnpm check:manifold flags the leaking forms.

blocks.name: Disposal scope
blocks.for: Run a rebuild and free every manifold object it kept afterwards, even when it throws, so the WASM heap does not grow on every slider step.

blocks.name: Chamfer cutter
blocks.for: The solid that chamfers the top or bottom edge of an extruded footprint when it is subtracted: one sloped face from a scaled extrusion, not a staircase, freeing everything it makes on the way.
